S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  C482 No. 2088 of 2023  With  IA No. 1 of 2023  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, Advocate, for the applicant.
Mr. V.K. Gemini, Deputy A.G., for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Prem Prakash Singh Phartiyal, Advocate, for respondent Nos. 2 and 3.

This C-482 Application is circumscribed with its own peculiar circumstances, wherein, the present applicant, who is languishing in jail, has preferred this C-482 Application though his father, Mr.
Balwant Singh, who is present in person, putting a challenge to the proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No. 37 of 2023, State Vs. Sachin Singh Rawat, whereby, the present applicant has been summoned to be tried for the offences under Sections 376, 506 of the IPC and Section 5 (j) (ii) and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

An irretrievable circumstance has arisen, because out of the relationship, which the respondent No.3, had with the present applicant, she conceived and later has delivered a male child on 23rd June, 2023, and owing to the assurance given by the applicant as recorded in her statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C., wherein, the applicant has assured, that he will be getting married with respondent No.3.
The said statement of the applicant is being recorded through his father.

On account of the fact, that it was a consensual relationship, and due to which, the victim has conceived, and later on delivered a child, continuing of the criminal litigation would be rather forcing the litigation upon the parties, who are otherwise at a platform, where they cannot go back to the normal life.

Thus while compounding this C-482 Application, and quashing of the proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No. 37 of 2023, pending consideration before the Court of Special Sessions Judge,
Chamoli, there are certain riders, which are being attached herein, which are as follow :-

1 i.

entities.text:
Court of Special Sessions Judge,
Chamoli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Having quashed the proceedings as above, it will automatically lead to implications which would flow from Sub-section (8) of Section 320 of the Cr.P.C.

Immediately, as a consequence of today's order, and upon release of the applicant,
who is presently languishing in jail, he through his father assures, that within a period of one month from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order, the applicant and respondent No.3, would be marrying as per accepted social norms, and also, that immediately after the marriage, the same would be registered before the Registrar of the Marriage.
It is only upon placement of aforesaid proof of marriage before the Special Sessions Judge, Chamoli, the proceedings would be ultimately quashed.

Subject to the aforesaid, the C-482 Application stands disposed of, with the liberty left open for the respondent Nos. 2 and 3 to file an appropriate recall application, if the applicant resile from any of the conditions as given above.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) Dated 18.10.2023 Shiv C482/2088/2023 on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45734985/
